in_marathi.name: Ayanaan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayanaan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ayanaan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ayan' which means 'Lord'. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Ayan, who is believed to be the presiding deity of the north direction and the lord of wisdom.
